question:
**Rearrange the following sentences in correct order to make a logical passage**.

1. Their unique features appeal to different consumer segments.

2. Mobile phone companies constantly innovate.

3. This intense competition drives technological advancements.

4. New models are released frequently with enhanced capabilities.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. 2-4-1-3 .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentences must be arranged logically to form a coherent passage.
 
• The correct sequence is:
 
 
• **2:** Mobile phone companies constantly innovate. (This introduces the main topic.)
 
• **4:** New models are released frequently with enhanced capabilities. (This explains how companies innovate.)
 
• **1:** Their unique features appeal to different consumer segments. (This highlights the results of innovation.)
 
• **3:** This intense competition drives technological advancements. (This concludes the passage by emphasizing competition.)
 
 

Correct sentence: *Mobile phone companies constantly innovate. New models are released frequently with enhanced capabilities. Their unique features appeal to different consumer segments. This intense competition drives technological advancements.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When arranging sentences, always identify:
 
 
• **Introduction:** The topic or subject being discussed.
 
• **Details:** Supporting points or explanations that follow logically.
 
• **Conclusion:** A statement that sums up or reinforces the ideas presented.
 
 
 
• Use logical connectors (e.g., "constantly," "frequently," "this") to identify relationships between sentences.
